answer: Weight each agent by its betweenness as a bridge: honest participants lie on many independent shortest paths linking distinct communities, forming a sprawling trellis of cross-group connections. A sybil farm only trades inward, a dense clique welded together like a single ferrous lump with almost no external bridging, so its betweenness centrality collapses toward zero. Padding the swarm with more clones adds no new bridges between communities, so each fake earns near-zero weight while a genuine connector keeps full standing.
